```{python}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('cleaned_inflation_with_calculations.csv')

# Convert time column to datetime
df['time'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], dayfirst=True)

# Extract year and month for analysis
df['Year'] = df['time'].dt.year
df['Month'] = df['time'].dt.month
df['Month_Name'] = df['time'].dt.strftime('%b')

# Calculate year-on-year percentage change for CPI
df['CPI_YoY'] = df['Consumer Price Index'].pct_change(12) * 100

# Calculate month-on-month percentage change for CPI
df['CPI_MoM'] = df['Consumer Price Index'].pct_change(1) * 100

# Sort the dataframe by time
df = df.sort_values('time').reset_index(drop=True)
```

# Overall Consumer Price Index Heatmap

## Year-on-Year Change

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6
#| label: fig-yoy-heatmap
#| fig-cap: "Consumer Price Index - Year-on-Year Change Heatmap"

# Calculate YoY and MoM on the full dataframe first
df['CPI_YoY'] = df['Consumer Price Index'].pct_change(12) * 100
df['CPI_MoM'] = df['Consumer Price Index'].pct_change(1) * 100

# Filter data for the last 7 years
current_year = df['Year'].max()
df_last_7_years = df[df['Year'] >= current_year - 6].copy()

# Create pivot table for YoY heatmap
month_labels = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 
                'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']

yoy_pivot = df_last_7_years.pivot_table(
    values='CPI_YoY', 
    index='Month', 
    columns='Year',
    aggfunc='first'
)

# Reindex to ensure all 12 months
yoy_pivot = yoy_pivot.reindex(index=range(1, 13))

# Create the heatmap using imshow
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))
vals = yoy_pivot.values

# Dynamic color scaling based on percentiles
finite_vals = vals[np.isfinite(vals)]
if finite_vals.size > 0:
    vmin = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals, 5)
    vmax = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals, 95)
else:
    vmin, vmax = -5, 5

# Create heatmap
im = ax.imshow(vals, aspect='auto', cmap='RdYlGn_r', vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)

# Set ticks and labels
ax.set_xticks(range(yoy_pivot.shape[1]))
ax.set_xticklabels(yoy_pivot.columns.astype(str), fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax.set_yticks(range(12))
ax.set_yticklabels(month_labels, fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Month', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12)
ax.set_title('Consumer Price Index - Year-on-Year Change (%)', 
             fontweight='bold', fontsize=14, pad=20)

# Annotate cells with values
for i in range(yoy_pivot.shape[0]):
    for j in range(yoy_pivot.shape[1]):
        val = yoy_pivot.values[i, j]
        if not np.isnan(val):
            # Adaptive text color for readability
            color_intensity = (val - vmin) / (vmax - vmin) if vmax != vmin else 0.5
            text_color = 'white' if color_intensity < 0.3 or color_intensity > 0.7 else 'black'
            ax.text(j, i, f"{val:.2f}", ha='center', va='center', 
                   fontsize=9, color=text_color, fontweight='bold')

# Add colorbar
cbar = fig.colorbar(im, ax=ax)
cbar.set_label('YoY Inflation (%)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# Category-wise Inflation Breakdown

This section shows how different CPI categories contribute to overall inflation, providing insights into which sectors are driving price changes.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Define major CPI categories and their column names
category_mapping = {
    'Food & Beverages': 'Consumer Price Index: Food and Beverages',
    'Pan, Tobacco & Intox': 'Consumer Price Index: Pan, Tobacco and Intoxicants',
    'Clothing & Footwear': 'Consumer Price Index: Clothing and Footwear',
    'Housing': 'Consumer Price Index: Housing',
    'Fuel & Light': 'Consumer Price Index: Fuel and Light',
    'Miscellaneous': 'Consumer Price Index: Miscellaneous'
}

# Calculate YoY% for each category
for short_name, col_name in category_mapping.items():
    if col_name in df.columns:
        df[f'{short_name}_YoY'] = df[col_name].pct_change(12) * 100

# Filter to last 3 years for clearer visualization
current_year_cat = df['Year'].max()
df_categories = df[df['Year'] >= current_year_cat - 2].copy()
```

```{python}
            change = current_val - prev_val
            arrow = "↑" if change > 0 else "↓" if change < 0 else "→"
            print(f"| {short_name} | {current_val:.2f}% | {prev_val:.2f}% | {arrow} {abs(change):.2f}pp |")
        elif pd.notna(current_val):
            print(f"| {short_name} | {current_val:.2f}% | N/A | - |")

# Identify highest and lowest categories
print("\n### Key Insights")

category_values = {}
for short_name in category_mapping.keys():
    yoy_col = f'{short_name}_YoY'
    if yoy_col in df_categories.columns:
        val = latest_cat_data[yoy_col]
        if pd.notna(val):
            category_values[short_name] = val

if category_values:
    highest_cat = max(category_values, key=category_values.get)
    lowest_cat = min(category_values, key=category_values.get)
    
    print(f"\n- **Highest inflation**: {highest_cat} at {category_values[highest_cat]:.2f}% YoY")
    print(f"- **Lowest inflation**: {lowest_cat} at {category_values[lowest_cat]:.2f}% YoY")
    
    # Check if any category is in deflation
    deflation_cats = [cat for cat, val in category_values.items() if val < 0]
    if deflation_cats:
        print(f"\n- **Categories in deflation**: {', '.join(deflation_cats)}")
```

# Top 5 Changes


```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Exclude synthetic/calculated columns AND top-level aggregates
meta_cols = ['time', 'Year', 'Month', 'Month_Name', 'CPI_YoY', 'CPI_MoM']

# Exact column names to exclude (top-level aggregates and synthetic indices)
EXCLUDE_EXACT = {
    'Consumer Price Index',  # Too generic - overall CPI
    'Consumer Food Price Index',  # We have detailed food categories
    'Core Bottom Up', 
    'Core Index', 
    'CPI (ExVeggies)', 
    'Core Ex TnC Index',
    'Core Core Exc Index', 
    'Custom Index 1', 
    'Custom Index 2', 
    'Exclusion Index',
    'RBI Core Index', 
    'Protein Index',
    'Consumer Price Index: exclude Food & Beverages and Fuel & Light',
    'Consumer Price Index: exclude Food and Beverages',
    'Consumer Price Index: Food and Beverages',  # Aggregate - we want sub-categories
    'Consumer Price Index: Miscellaneous',  # Aggregate - we want sub-categories
    'Consumer Price Index: Clothing and Footwear'  # Aggregate - we want sub-categories
}

EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS = [
    'Custom Index', 'Core Index', 'Core Bottom Up', 'Core Ex TnC',
    'Core Core Exc', 'Exclusion Index', 'RBI Core Index', 'Protein Index',
    '(ExVeggies)', 'exclude Food'
]

def is_excluded(colname: str) -> bool:
    """Check if column should be excluded"""
    # Check exact matches first
    if colname in EXCLUDE_EXACT:
        return True
    # Check keywords
    for kw in EXCLUDE_KEYWORDS:
        if kw.lower() in colname.lower():
            return True
    return False

# Get only granular CPI component columns
candidates = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]
cpi_cols = [c for c in candidates if not is_excluded(c)]

# Get latest and previous month indices
latest_idx = df.index[-1]
prev_idx = df.index[-2]

latest_date = df.loc[latest_idx, 'time'].strftime('%B %Y')
prev_date = df.loc[prev_idx, 'time'].strftime('%B %Y')

# Calculate month-on-month changes for all components
rows = []
for col in cpi_cols:
    prev_v = df.loc[prev_idx, col]
    cur_v = df.loc[latest_idx, col]
    if pd.notna(prev_v) and pd.notna(cur_v) and prev_v != 0:
        change = ((cur_v - prev_v) / prev_v) * 100
        # Only include if there's actual change (not zero or negligible)
        if abs(change) > 0.01:  # Filter out negligible changes
            rows.append({
                'Category': col,
                'MoM Change (%)': change
            })

# Create dataframe and sort by change
changes_df = pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('MoM Change (%)', ascending=False)

# Get top 5 increases and decreases (only if they exist)
top_5_increases = changes_df[changes_df['MoM Change (%)'] > 0].head(5).copy()
top_5_decreases = changes_df[changes_df['MoM Change (%)'] < 0].tail(5).copy()

# Shorten category names for display
def shorten_name(s, max_len=35):
    """Shorten category names for better display with word wrapping"""
    # Handle special case for overall CPI first
    if s == 'Consumer Price Index':
        return 'Overall CPI'
    
    # Remove nested prefixes iteratively (handles "Consumer Price Index: Food and Beverages: Fruits")
    prefixes_to_remove = [
        'Consumer Price Index: ',
        'Food and Beverages: ',
        'Miscellaneous: ',
        'Clothing and Footwear: ',

    ]
    
    # Keep removing prefixes until none match (handles nested structures)
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        for prefix in prefixes_to_remove:
            if s.startswith(prefix):
                s = s[len(prefix):]
                changed = True
                break
    
    # If still too long, truncate intelligently
    if len(s) > max_len:
        s = s[:max_len-3] + '...'
    return s

top_5_increases['Category'] = top_5_increases['Category'].apply(shorten_name)
top_5_decreases['Category'] = top_5_decreases['Category'].apply(shorten_name)

# Combine for visualization
combined = pd.concat([top_5_increases, top_5_decreases]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false

# Create figure with proper spacing
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 8))

# Prepare data
categories = list(top_5_increases['Category']) + list(top_5_decreases['Category'])
changes = list(top_5_increases['MoM Change (%)']) + list(top_5_decreases['MoM Change (%)'])

# Create positions for bars
y_positions = np.arange(len(categories))

# Color bars based on positive/negative
colors = ['#d62728' if x > 0 else '#2ca02c' for x in changes]

# Create horizontal bar chart
bars = ax.barh(y_positions, changes, color=colors, alpha=0.85, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8)

# Calculate x-axis range with padding for labels
max_val = max(abs(min(changes)), abs(max(changes)))
ax.set_xlim([-max_val * 1.3, max_val * 1.3])

# Add value labels at the end of bars (inside plot area)
for i, (pos, val) in enumerate(zip(y_positions, changes)):
    if val > 0:
        # Place label at the end of the bar for positive values
        ax.text(val + max_val * 0.03, pos, f'{val:+.2f}%', 
               va='center', ha='left', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='black')
    else:
        # Place label at the end of the bar for negative values
        ax.text(val - max_val * 0.03, pos, f'{val:+.2f}%', 
               va='center', ha='right', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='black')

# Customize plot
ax.set_yticks(y_positions)
ax.set_yticklabels(categories, fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_xlabel('Month-on-Month Change (%)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
ax.set_title(f'Top Price Movers: {prev_date} to {latest_date}', 
             fontweight='bold', fontsize=13, pad=20)
ax.axvline(x=0, color='black', linewidth=1.5, linestyle='-', alpha=0.7)
ax.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add legend
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
legend_elements = [
    Patch(facecolor='#d62728', alpha=0.85, edgecolor='black', label='Inflationary (Increase)'),
    Patch(facecolor='#2ca02c', alpha=0.85, edgecolor='black', label='Deflationary (Decrease)')
]
ax.legend(handles=legend_elements, loc='lower right', frameon=True, fontsize=9, shadow=True)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Year-on-Year Top Movers

```{python}
#| echo: false

# Get latest and year-ago indices for YoY calculation
latest_idx_yoy = df.index[-1]
year_ago_idx = df.index[-13] if len(df) >= 13 else df.index[0]

latest_date_yoy = df.loc[latest_idx_yoy, 'time'].strftime('%B %Y')
year_ago_date_yoy = df.loc[year_ago_idx, 'time'].strftime('%B %Y')

# Calculate year-on-year changes for all components
rows_yoy = []
for col in cpi_cols:
    year_ago_v = df.loc[year_ago_idx, col]
    cur_v = df.loc[latest_idx_yoy, col]
    if pd.notna(year_ago_v) and pd.notna(cur_v) and year_ago_v != 0:
        change = ((cur_v - year_ago_v) / year_ago_v) * 100
        # Only include if there's actual change (not zero or negligible)
        if abs(change) > 0.01:  # Filter out negligible changes
            rows_yoy.append({
                'Category': col,
                'YoY Change (%)': change
            })

# Create dataframe and sort by change
changes_yoy_df = pd.DataFrame(rows_yoy).sort_values('YoY Change (%)', ascending=False)

# Get top 5 increases and decreases (only if they exist)
top_5_increases_yoy = changes_yoy_df[changes_yoy_df['YoY Change (%)'] > 0].head(5).copy()
top_5_decreases_yoy = changes_yoy_df[changes_yoy_df['YoY Change (%)'] < 0].tail(5).copy()

# Shorten category names for display

top_5_decreases_yoy['Category'] = top_5_decreases_yoy['Category'].apply(shorten_name)

# Combine for visualization
combined_yoy = pd.concat([top_5_increases_yoy, top_5_decreases_yoy]).reset_index(drop=True)
```

# Inflation Dispersion Analysis

This section analyzes how inflation is distributed across different CPI components, showing whether price changes are broad-based or concentrated in specific items.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Prepare dispersion data
# Filter to granular CPI components (exclude aggregate indices)
meta_cols = ['time', 'Year', 'Month', 'Month_Name', 'CPI_YoY', 'CPI_MoM']

# Get granular CPI columns (reuse existing exclusion logic)
candidates = [c for c in df.columns if c not in meta_cols]
cpi_components = [c for c in candidates if not is_excluded(c)]

# Calculate YoY for all components
component_yoy = pd.DataFrame({'time': df['time']})
for col in cpi_components:
    component_yoy[col] = df[col].pct_change(12) * 100

# Filter to last 7 years
current_year = df['Year'].max()
df_dispersion = component_yoy[pd.to_datetime(component_yoy['time']).dt.year >= current_year - 6].copy()

# Define inflation brackets (simplified)
def categorize_inflation(value):
    if pd.isna(value):
        return None
    elif value < 0:
        return 'Deflation (< 0%)'
    elif value < 2:
        return 'Low (0-2%)'
    elif value < 4:
        return 'Moderate (2-4%)'
    elif value < 6:
        return 'High (4-6%)'
    else:
        return 'Very High (> 6%)'

# Create dispersion dataframe
dispersion_data = []
for idx, row in df_dispersion.iterrows():
    time_val = row['time']
    values = [row[col] for col in cpi_components if pd.notna(row[col])]
    
    # Categorize each component
    categories = [categorize_inflation(v) for v in values if categorize_inflation(v) is not None]
    
    # Count items in each bracket
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(categories)
    
    dispersion_data.append({
        'time': time_val,
        'Deflation (< 0%)': counts.get('Deflation (< 0%)', 0),
        'Low (0-2%)': counts.get('Low (0-2%)', 0),
        'Moderate (2-4%)': counts.get('Moderate (2-4%)', 0),
        'High (4-6%)': counts.get('High (4-6%)', 0),
        'Very High (> 6%)': counts.get('Very High (> 6%)', 0),
        'Total': len(categories)
    })

disp_df = pd.DataFrame(dispersion_data)

# Calculate percentages
for cat in ['Deflation (< 0%)', 'Low (0-2%)', 'Moderate (2-4%)', 'High (4-6%)', 'Very High (> 6%)']:
    disp_df[f'{cat}_pct'] = (disp_df[cat] / disp_df['Total']) * 100
```

## Annualized MoM Threshold Analysis



```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Get current month and same month last year
latest_data = disp_df.iloc[-1]
year_ago_data = disp_df.iloc[-13] if len(disp_df) >= 13 else disp_df.iloc[0]

latest_date = pd.to_datetime(latest_data['time']).strftime('%B %Y')
year_ago_date = pd.to_datetime(year_ago_data['time']).strftime('%B %Y')

# Calculate MoM for all components
component_mom = pd.DataFrame({'time': df['time']})
for col in cpi_components:
    component_mom[col] = df[col].pct_change(1) * 100  # MoM as percentage

# Filter to last 7 years
df_mom_dispersion = component_mom[pd.to_datetime(component_mom['time']).dt.year >= current_year - 6].copy()

# Create dispersion dataframes for two thresholds
# Threshold 1: 0.5% MoM ≈ 6% annualized
# Threshold 2: 0.33% MoM ≈ 4% annualized

threshold_6_data = []
threshold_4_data = []

for idx, row in df_mom_dispersion.iterrows():
    time_val = row['time']
    values = [row[col] for col in cpi_components if pd.notna(row[col])]
    
    if len(values) > 0:
        # 6% threshold (0.5% MoM)
        below_6 = sum(1 for v in values if v < 0.5)
        above_6 = sum(1 for v in values if v >= 0.5)
        total = len(values)
        
        threshold_6_data.append({
            'time': time_val,
            'Below_0.5': below_6,
            'Above_0.5': above_6,
            'Total': total,
            'Below_0.5_pct': (below_6 / total) * 100,
            'Above_0.5_pct': (above_6 / total) * 100
        })
        
        # 4% threshold (0.33% MoM)
        below_4 = sum(1 for v in values if v < 0.33)
        above_4 = sum(1 for v in values if v >= 0.33)
        
        threshold_4_data.append({
            'time': time_val,
            'Below_0.33': below_4,
            'Above_0.33': above_4,
            'Total': total,
            'Below_0.33_pct': (below_4 / total) * 100,
            'Above_0.33_pct': (above_4 / total) * 100
        })

thresh_6_df = pd.DataFrame(threshold_6_data)
thresh_4_df = pd.DataFrame(threshold_4_data)
```

```{python}
# Add annotations at right edge

if latest_6['Above_0.5_pct'] > 5:  # Only if visible
```

```{python}
print(f"\n#### 6% Annualized Threshold")

count_above_6_mom = int(latest_6_thresh['Above_0.5'])

if pct_above_6_mom > 70:

    signal_6 = "suggesting **strong upward price pressures** that may warrant policy attention"
elif pct_above_6_mom > 50:
    breadth_6 = "**broad-based**"
    signal_6 = "indicating **elevated inflation momentum** across most categories"
elif pct_above_6_mom > 30:
    breadth_6 = "**moderately spread**"
    signal_6 = "showing **mixed inflationary pressures** across the basket"
else:
    breadth_6 = "**concentrated in select items**"
    signal_6 = "suggesting **contained inflation** with most components cooling"

print(f"\n- **{pct_above_6_mom:.1f}%** ({count_above_6_mom} components) are currently inflating above the 6% annualized pace (>0.5% MoM)")
print(f"\n- Inflation pressure is {breadth_6}, {signal_6}")

# 4% threshold insights
print(f"\n#### 4% Annualized Threshold")
pct_above_4_mom = latest_4_thresh['Above_0.33_pct']
count_above_4_mom = int(latest_4_thresh['Above_0.33'])

if pct_above_4_mom < 30:
    breadth_4 = "**below the 4% lower bound**"
    signal_4 = "potentially signaling room for **policy easing**"
elif pct_above_4_mom < 50:
    breadth_4 = "**near or below the RBI's tolerance band**"
    signal_4 = "suggesting **moderate inflationary pressures**"
else:
    breadth_4 = "**above the 4% lower bound**"
    signal_4 = "indicating **sustained inflation momentum**"

print(f"\n- **{pct_above_4_mom:.1f}%** ({count_above_4_mom} components) are inflating above the 4% annualized pace (>0.33% MoM)")

# Year-over-year comparison
if len(thresh_6_df) >= 13:
    year_ago_6 = thresh_6_df.iloc[-13]
    year_ago_4 = thresh_4_df.iloc[-13]
    year_ago_date_thresh = pd.to_datetime(year_ago_6['time']).strftime('%B %Y')
    
    change_6 = pct_above_6_mom - year_ago_6['Above_0.5_pct']
    change_4 = pct_above_4_mom - year_ago_4['Above_0.33_pct']
    
    print(f"\n#### Change from Year Ago ({year_ago_date_thresh})")
    
    if abs(change_6) > 10:
        direction_6 = "increased" if change_6 > 0 else "decreased"
        print(f"\n- The share of components above 6% annualized pace has **{direction_6} by {abs(change_6):.1f} percentage points**")
    else:
        print(f"\n- The share of components above 6% annualized pace has remained **relatively stable** ({change_6:+.1f} pp)")
    
    if abs(change_4) > 10:
        direction_4 = "increased" if change_4 > 0 else "decreased"
        print(f"\n- The share of components above 4% annualized pace has **{direction_4} by {abs(change_4):.1f} percentage points**")
    else:
        print(f"\n- The share of components above 4% annualized pace has remained **relatively stable** ({change_4:+.1f} pp)")

# 12-month trend
if len(thresh_6_df) >= 12:
    twelve_months_6 = thresh_6_df.iloc[-12:]
    twelve_months_4 = thresh_4_df.iloc[-12:]
    
    trend_6 = np.polyfit(range(12), twelve_months_6['Above_0.5_pct'].values, 1)[0]
    trend_4 = np.polyfit(range(12), twelve_months_4['Above_0.33_pct'].values, 1)[0]
    
    print(f"\n#### 12-Month Trend")
    
    if abs(trend_6) > 0.5:
        trend_dir_6 = "upward" if trend_6 > 0 else "downward"
        print(f"\n- Components above 6% threshold show a **{trend_dir_6} trend** over the past year")
    else:
        print(f"\n- Components above 6% threshold show **no clear trend** over the past year")
    
    if abs(trend_4) > 0.5:
        trend_dir_4 = "upward" if trend_4 > 0 else "downward"
        print(f"\n- Components above 4% threshold show a **{trend_dir_4} trend** over the past year")
    else:
        print(f"\n- Components above 4% threshold show **no clear trend** over the past year")
```

# Seasonality Analysis

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# Helper function to create dual heatmaps
def create_seasonality_heatmap(df_data, column_name, title_prefix):
    # Calculate YoY and MoM for the column
    yoy_col = f'{column_name}_YoY_temp'
    mom_col = f'{column_name}_MoM_temp'
    df_data[yoy_col] = df_data[column_name].pct_change(12) * 100
    df_data[mom_col] = df_data[column_name].pct_change(1) * 100
    
    # Filter last 7 years
    current_year = df_data['Year'].max()
    df_filtered = df_data[df_data['Year'] >= current_year - 6].copy()
    
    # Create pivot tables
    yoy_pivot = df_filtered.pivot_table(values=yoy_col, index='Month', columns='Year', aggfunc='first')
    mom_pivot = df_filtered.pivot_table(values=mom_col, index='Month', columns='Year', aggfunc='first')
    
    yoy_pivot = yoy_pivot.reindex(index=range(1, 13))
    mom_pivot = mom_pivot.reindex(index=range(1, 13))
    
    # Create figure with 2 subplots
    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 6))
    
    month_labels = ['Jan', 'Feb', 'Mar', 'Apr', 'May', 'Jun', 
                    'Jul', 'Aug', 'Sep', 'Oct', 'Nov', 'Dec']
    
    # YoY Heatmap (Left)
    vals_yoy = yoy_pivot.values
    finite_vals_yoy = vals_yoy[np.isfinite(vals_yoy)]
    if finite_vals_yoy.size > 0:
        vmin_yoy = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals_yoy, 5)
        vmax_yoy = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals_yoy, 95)
    else:
        vmin_yoy, vmax_yoy = -5, 5
    
    im1 = ax1.imshow(vals_yoy, aspect='auto', cmap='RdYlGn_r', vmin=vmin_yoy, vmax=vmax_yoy)
    ax1.set_xticks(range(yoy_pivot.shape[1]))
    ax1.set_xticklabels(yoy_pivot.columns.astype(str), fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax1.set_yticks(range(12))
    ax1.set_yticklabels(month_labels, fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax1.set_xlabel('Year', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
    ax1.set_ylabel('Month', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
    ax1.set_title(f'{title_prefix} - YoY Change (%)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12, pad=15)
    
    for i in range(yoy_pivot.shape[0]):
        for j in range(yoy_pivot.shape[1]):
            val = yoy_pivot.values[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color_intensity = (val - vmin_yoy) / (vmax_yoy - vmin_yoy) if vmax_yoy != vmin_yoy else 0.5
                text_color = 'white' if color_intensity < 0.3 or color_intensity > 0.7 else 'black'
                ax1.text(j, i, f"{val:.2f}", ha='center', va='center', 
                        fontsize=8, color=text_color, fontweight='bold')
    
    cbar1 = fig.colorbar(im1, ax=ax1)
    cbar1.set_label('YoY %', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    
    # MoM Heatmap (Right)
    vals_mom = mom_pivot.values
    finite_vals_mom = vals_mom[np.isfinite(vals_mom)]
    if finite_vals_mom.size > 0:
        vmin_mom = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals_mom, 5)
        vmax_mom = np.nanpercentile(finite_vals_mom, 95)
    else:
        vmin_mom, vmax_mom = -2, 2
    
    im2 = ax2.imshow(vals_mom, aspect='auto', cmap='RdYlGn_r', vmin=vmin_mom, vmax=vmax_mom)
    ax2.set_xticks(range(mom_pivot.shape[1]))
    ax2.set_xticklabels(mom_pivot.columns.astype(str), fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax2.set_yticks(range(12))
    ax2.set_yticklabels(month_labels, fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    ax2.set_xlabel('Year', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
    ax2.set_ylabel('Month', fontweight='bold', fontsize=11)
    ax2.set_title(f'{title_prefix} - MoM Change (%)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=12, pad=15)
    
    for i in range(mom_pivot.shape[0]):
        for j in range(mom_pivot.shape[1]):
            val = mom_pivot.values[i, j]
            if not np.isnan(val):
                color_intensity = (val - vmin_mom) / (vmax_mom - vmin_mom) if vmax_mom != vmin_mom else 0.5
                text_color = 'white' if color_intensity < 0.3 or color_intensity > 0.7 else 'black'
                ax2.text(j, i, f"{val:.2f}", ha='center', va='center', 
                        fontsize=8, color=text_color, fontweight='bold')
    
    cbar2 = fig.colorbar(im2, ax=ax2)
    cbar2.set_label('MoM %', fontweight='bold', fontsize=10)
    
    plt.tight_layout()
    plt.show()
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Calculate YoY for the four categories

df['Core_YoY'] = df['Core Index'].pct_change(12) * 100

# Filter to last 7 years for clarity
current_year = df['Year'].max()
df_plot = df[df['Year'] >= current_year - 6].copy()

# Create the line chart
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 7))

# Plot the four lines
ax.plot(df_plot['time'], df_plot['CPI_YoY'],
        color='#1f77b4', linewidth=2.5, label='Overall CPI', marker='o', markersize=4, alpha=0.9)

ax.plot(df_plot['time'], df_plot['ExVeggies_YoY'],
        color='#ff7f0e', linewidth=2.5, label='CPI (Ex Veggies)', marker='s', markersize=4, alpha=0.9)

        color='#2ca02c', linewidth=2.5, label='Core CPI', marker='^', markersize=4, alpha=0.9)

ax.plot(df_plot['time'], df_plot['ExGold_YoY'],
        color='#9467bd', linewidth=2.5, label='CPI (Ex Gold)', marker='D', markersize=4, alpha=0.9)

# Add reference bands at 4% and 6%
ax.axhline(y=4, color='red', linewidth=2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, label='LB (4%)')
ax.axhline(y=6, color='red', linewidth=2, linestyle='--', alpha=0.6, label='UB (6%)')

# Styling
ax.set_xlabel('Time Period', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)
ax.set_ylabel('Year-on-Year Change (%)', fontweight='bold', fontsize=13)
ax.set_title('Year-on-Year Inflation Trends - Key CPI Categories (Last 7 Years)',
             fontweight='bold', fontsize=15, pad=20)

ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3, linestyle='--', linewidth=0.7)
ax.axhline(y=0, color='black', linewidth=1, linestyle='-', alpha=0.5)

ax.legend(loc='best', fontsize=11, frameon=True, shadow=True, fancybox=True)

# Date formatting
ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(mdates.YearLocator())
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mdates.DateFormatter('%Y'))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(mdates.MonthLocator((1, 7)))
plt.xticks(rotation=0, ha='center', fontweight='bold')
plt.yticks(fontweight='bold')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
